garden.notes: Prefer sunny, usable, reasonably level/fenceable space.

kitchen.notes: Spend a lot of time in the kitchen; weight layout/function, prep area, storage, appliance placement, natural light, finishes, and upgrade burden.

mudroom.notes: Entry area off garage should contain coats/shoes/bags without invading the main living area.

pantry.notes: Decent pantry preferred; cabinetry alone should not automatically count as a pantry.

garage_outbuilding.ideal: Usable 3+ car garage; in a subdivision, an existing or permitted garden shed is preferred
garage_outbuilding.acceptable: 2+ car garage plus a decent-sized garden shed, subject to actual storage needs
garage_outbuilding.notes: Garage capacity is the main storage priority. With a usable 3+ car garage, external storage matters less. Verify stall dimensions, vehicle/workbench/tool storage, and any existing shed or permission for a small resin or wood shed. Do not penalize a subdivision property merely because a 30×40 workshop is unavailable.

basement_storage.notes: Need decent unfinished utility/storage space even when basement has finished rooms.

lot_privacy.notes: Favor larger lots, mature trees, natural areas, wildlife, usable yard, low neighbor exposure, and low future-development risk.

children_outdoors.notes: Favor practical play space and usable outdoor areas.

outbuilding_potential.subdivision_guidance: Assume a large detached workshop is outside the normal buyer expectation; prioritize 3+ car garage and a garden shed or legal ability to add a small resin/wood shed. Still verify private covenants and municipal rules; subdivision status alone does not prove a prohibition.
outbuilding_potential.outside_subdivision_or_larger_lot_guidan: Legal and physical ability to add a larger shed someday is a bonus, not a universal 30×40 requirement. Check zoning, covenants, setbacks, septic/reserve, easements, slope and access.
outbuilding_potential.scoring_guidance: Use the combined garage_outbuilding category once; do not impose a separate workshop penalty or double count optional future buildings. Unknown shed permission stays unknown, rather than prohibited.

taxes.notes: Low carrying cost matters; compare taxes to plausible purchase price, not assessment alone.

resale.notes: Prefer durable resale traits: useful land, functional layout, garage, setting, tax burden, condition, and access.

house_size.notes: Daily shortlist: exclude homes below 2,500 total finished living square feet. When an above-/below-grade split is available, require at least 2,000 above-grade finished square feet. If the split is unavailable, a supported total finished area of at least 2,500 may qualify, but explicitly flag above-grade area as unknown. Do not count unfinished basement, garage, outbuilding or potential future finishing toward the minimum, or double-count below-grade space already included in a total. Resolve material area conflicts before recommending. Price, acreage or garage capacity do not override these minimums. Full evaluations requested explicitly by the buyer may still assess a smaller property and should flag the mismatch.

scoring.guidance: Score is a comparison aid, not a valuation model. Missing categories are renormalized. Final property and offer conclusions remain judgment-based.

anchors.9-10: Verified generously usable 3+ car garage with adequate storage; existing suitable garden shed or documented ability to add one strengthens fit.
anchors.7-8: Usable 3-car garage with shed permission unknown, or 2+ car garage with a suitable shed; actual dimensions and storage usability determine rating.
anchors.5-6: Limited garage/storage function and no confirmed compensating shed; assess dimensions and buyer use.

garage_outbuilding_guidance.notes: Anchors guide evidence-based judgment, not automatic ratings. No workshop penalty for subdivision homes. Keep unknown dimensions/permissions explicit. A 30×40 GARDEN remains high priority.

location_comparison.notes: Treat either ~5 minutes or ~15% change as potentially material; Lisa work commute should also consider weekday traffic.
